You are the new manager (CEO) for AntiQuickPad, taking over from a Sonnet 5.5 session. OVERNIGHT RUN: the user is asleep. Do not wait for answers or approval. Two items, on ONE new branch.

Items (Route C): F37-hidden-selftest-windows (P0) and a gated slice of M9-function-contract-separation (P0): parts a, d, e, then b. Part c (Editor/Carousel behaviour split) is OUT OF SCOPE tonight.

Setup
- Repo: F:\LocalVSProj\Visual Studio Apps\AntiQuickPad. Branch feat/function-contract-separation off dev (94c0f6f or later). Commit per step. Never merge to dev or main, never push, never delete branches, never touch spikes/ or feat/ui-auditor. Dirty files you may ignore: the atlas json and two untracked .coord/reports/routing-test.*.codex.md.
- Read in order: AGENTS.md, .coord/STATUS.md, .coord/HANDOFF.md, docs/feedback/TRACKER.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/agents.md (the Routing section is how you dispatch), docs/product-checklist.md, last 5 entries of docs/decisions-log.md.

Context
- Stack: Avalonia + AvaloniaEdit. Core loop is user-passed. Quiet and Card shells (light/dark) exist.
- User plan: finish core function on the CURRENT UI, then separate function from UI (M9), then a UI-only overhaul. All current-shell polish is ON HOLD (originals in docs/feedback/held-ui-items.md). Do not fix UI items. Search is not in scope.
- M9 goal: when the user later asks for a UI/theme change, it is obvious which functions to call and nothing underneath can break.

Steps, in this order
1. F37-hidden-selftest-windows: selftest and render runs must not pop windows or take focus over the user's pad (hidden/off-screen). Commit.
2. Baseline BEFORE any M9 code: run `dotnet bin/Release/net10.0/AntiQuickPad.dll --quit` (never kill the process), Release build, --selftest, --measure. Save to .coord/reports/M9-baseline.md (warnings, selftest result, median/p95 show-to-focus; M5 reference is 11 ms median, 100 ms budget). Commit.
3. M9 part a: function contract table, new doc docs/function-contract.md (seed: docs/product-checklist.md). Every function -> command ID -> owner (Core / ViewModel / Controller) -> how reachable (toolbar, menu, hotkey, gesture). Commit.
4. M9 part d: conformance smoke check. It enumerates the contract's commands and fails if the active shell does not expose each one. Run it for Quiet and Card. Commit.
5. M9 part e: AGENTS.md rule, kept minimal, detail in docs: function tasks never touch layouts/tokens; UI tasks never touch Core, ViewModels or the controller. Commit.
6. M9 part b: extract lifecycle, the 350 ms save debounce, the navigation protocol (save, switch, restore scroll and focus, save-failure cancels navigation), the focus cue and show/hide from Views/Common/ResidentShellWindow* into a shell-agnostic controller. Shells only place controls and bind commands. Do it in small sub-steps, one commit each.
   Gate after EVERY code step: Release build 0 warnings, --selftest PASS, conformance check PASS, --measure within budget and not worse than baseline by more than ~20%. Gate fails and two fix attempts fail -> `git revert` that step, record why, then stop M9 part b (do not push on). Observable behaviour must not change.

Dispatch rules (Codex first, Claude manages)
- Dispatch ONLY through .coord/tools/codex-run.sh <director|worker|backup> <ID-slug> <task-file>. Its caps are the usage budget: director 3, worker 2, backup 1. Set CODEX_BUDGET_TAG=night-2026-10-21 so the budget does not reset at midnight, and CODEX_TIMEOUT_MIN=90 for the part b extraction. Run it in the background; its exit wakes you. Never poll. On STOP, write HANDOFF.md and end.
- Directors gpt-6.1-sol medium; workers gpt-6-luna high; backup gpt-5.6-luna xhigh. Sandbox workspace-write only, never full access. Build needs AVALONIA_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 inside the Codex sandbox; you run restore (Codex has no network).
- When you launch a run, tell the user in one line: working folder, task file, log/report path.
- Task briefs in .coord/tasks/<ID-slug>.md, reports in .coord/reports/. One writer per folder at a time. Tests are small disposable smoke checks.

Bookkeeping
- Name every item/task <ID>-<short-slug> everywhere (chat, briefs, commits, reports). Never a bare ID.
- Update .coord/STATUS.md at every dispatch, milestone and completion. Update docs/feedback/TRACKER.md in the same step as ANY status change (keep the table shape). F37-hidden-selftest-windows -> "Awaiting your check" when done. M9-function-contract-separation stays "Pending your check", never Done; note that part c remains.
- Log every judgement call in .coord/reports/M9-function-contract-separation.md under "Decisions made unattended".

Stop when: steps 1-6 are done, or a gate/dispatch STOP hits. Final message to the user is ONE short report: what landed (commit hashes), what was reverted and why, test and measure numbers vs baseline, and a numbered "needs your physical check" list last (hotkey show/hide, focus lands in editor, autosave and relaunch restore, note switching by wheel, folding, tray menu, F37: run --selftest and confirm no windows appear).
